entities.name: PMID:25085362
observations: Neuro-Oncology (2015) study reports that adult mouse SVZ CXCL12 promotes GBM/GSC migration and SVZ invasion through CXCR4 in tested models.

entities.name: CXCL12-CXCR4 promotes SVZ invasion
observations: In tested GBM xenograft models, CXCR4 pharmacologic inhibition (AMD3100) and genetic invalidation reduced/prevented SVZ invasion; CXCR4 inhibition also reduced migration toward SVZ-conditioned medium. This supports pathway contribution, not exclusivity, because SVZ-conditioned medium contains multiple cues.
